verdict.rationale: The only background automation in evidence is built-in automated visa-expiry and renewal reminders and alerts. These are vendor-defined notifications, not automations the user configures and that act autonomously; the rest of the process is run by human case managers and attorneys. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, autonomous background task execution, triggers/actions or agentic capabilities, a public API (OpenAPI probe returned 404), independent corroboration.
